notes: §1985:XIII.3.13.4 GR2: with neither PAGE nor CONTROL an indicated item 'is presented the first time its detail is presented after the INITIATE statement is executed. Thereafter spaces are supplied for indicated items with SOURCE or VALUE clauses.' INITIATE calls ArmGroupIndicate (every detail's GroupIndicatePending set); PresentBody copies the group's flag to GroupIndicatePresent, which EmitFieldPlacements' guard reads so an unindicated item places nothing (its columns stay spaces) while its LINE is still presented; GenerateCore clears the flag at 85 only when the group was presented (DialectBehavior.GroupIndicateConsumedByIssuedGenerate inactive, PB5246). Probes at --std 85: the witness (HDR 1, 2, 3; HDR 4, 5 after a second INITIATE); a format-3 entry with its own LINE and GROUP INDICATE prints HDR then an empty line, a SOURCE alphanumeric and a signed edited -ZZ9 item print SRC1 / -  5 then spaces while the unindicated -ZZ9 prints 7; a second detail is indicated on its own first presentation and 70 further GENERATEs with no PAGE clause never re-indicate; GROUP INDICATE twice (COBOL2423), in a REPORT FOOTING (COBOL2519) and a 2002 PRESENT WHEN (COBOL0900) are refused.

next.reason: 1985: 'is presented the first time its detail is presented after the INITIATE statement is executed. Thereafter spaces are supplied' (the item stays in the group, as spaces, and its LINE is presented). 2023: 'The GROUP INDICATE clause has the same effect as a PRESENT WHEN clause', whose false condition makes the item absent 'as though the entry were omitted from the description of the report group' (13.18.41.4 GR2 b): the entry and its LINE clause go. A 1985 format 3 entry may carry LINE beside GROUP INDICATE, so a program both editions accept prints one line fewer under 2023.
